messages.subject: Project Aquilo - Schedule 3 pricing model
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

Attached is the pricing and volume model that will form Schedule 3. It shows the Year 1 unit prices (with framework discounts), an indicative Year 1 order plan of about £4.25m against the £3.5m minimum commitment, and a 5-year projection with CPI indexation capped at 4%. There's also a worked shortfall example at 8%. Please confirm this is the version to attach to the execution copy.

Best,

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0048
whitfieldcarter.com
